Blog Post on Omer Dotan. לאדריכלות בישרא: Blog Post on Omer Dotan. VR solutions for architecture in Israel.
המונח \"גיימיפיקציה\" מתאר את שילובם של: The term "gamification" describes bringing principles and technologies from computer games (gaming) into fields that are not games by nature. This is not unique to architecture; it shows up in many industries, partly because the gaming world has contributed so much to breakthrough technology.
השפעות הגיימינג בתעשייה – דוגמה מהמפעלים: Gaming's influence on industry - an example from Japanese factories
ביפן, למשל, ניתן למצוא מפעלי רכב המשכילי: In Japan, for example, there are car factories that have installed colorful digital boards on the floors of the car-body assembly lines, boards that look like the score boards of computer games. This helps motivate workers and makes the work environment more fun and more efficient.
היבטים עיקריים של גיימיפיקציה באדריכלות: Main aspects of gamification in architecture
יכולת היצירה של תחושת \"אימרסיה\" – חווי: Creating a sense of "immersion" - an experience where the user feels they are in a real world, not an imagined one - depends largely on the level of the visuals. Epic Games' Unreal game engine is a clear example: it allows building complex physical worlds that are realistic in how objects, materials and light behave. This technology was adopted for architecture in Twinmotion, which translates the achievements of gaming into a realistic, innovative design language for project visualizations too.
עולם הגיימינג תרם רבות גם לתחום ממשקי המ: The gaming world has also contributed a lot to user interfaces, which give an interactive experience that engages both the user's senses and emotions, using advanced graphics and intuitive, precise actions. The user interface is the bridge between the person and the creation - whether a game or an architectural project - and it includes tools for precise movement in space and clear, accessible orientation maps.
העברת סיפור ונרטיב: Telling a story and a narrative
הן בגיימינג והן באדריכלות קיים עיקרון מר: Both gaming and architecture share a central principle of passing on a message or a story. The ability to "tell a story" is an important layer of the gamification tools used in modern architectural design.
יישום גיימיפיקציה בסיורי VR מוכנים מראש: Applying gamification in ready-made VR tours
סיורי VR מוכנים מראש נשענים רבות על עקרו: Ready-made VR tours rely heavily on principles from the gaming world, to present the project in the right, most efficient and most engaging way. Adding game-like elements, born in the gaming world and adapted to architecture, directly raises users' motivation and involvement - all without taking anything away from the quality of the design itself.
